title: Finding
description: Schema for a single cloud misconfiguration finding produced by the detection/scoring pipeline.

rule_id.description: Identifier of the rule that produced this finding, e.g. 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS'.

scan_id.description: Identifier grouping all findings from the same scan run (UUID).

region.description: AWS region, or 'global' for IAM resources.

severity_raw.description: Base severity assigned by the rule definition, before scoring/weighting.

risk_score.description: Computed risk score for this finding.

score_breakdown.description: Transparent list of factors that contributed to the risk score.

factor.description: Short identifier for the contributing factor, e.g. 'public_access'.

weight.description: Points contributed to the total risk_score by this factor.

description.description: Short human-readable reason for this factor's inclusion.

compliance_mappings.description: Compliance frameworks and clauses this finding relates to.

clause_description.description: Short description of the requirement being violated.

issue.description: Plain-English description of what is wrong.

projected_score_after_fix.description: Estimated risk_score after the recommended fix is applied.

status.description: Current workflow status of this finding.

detected_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this finding was first detected.

last_seen_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this finding was last confirmed present.
